t: The Prysmian 6243YH 1.5mm² 3-core and earth cable handles cooker circuits and higher-load applications in domestic installations. This 100m drum provides continuous length for substantial projects without joins, reducing installation time and connection failures. Solid copper core wire maintains rigidity for straightforward routing through walls and conduit, whilst the grey PVC sheath resists damage and performs reliably across -15 to 70°C temperature ranges. The three-conductor design with earth provides flexibility for complex circuits requiring multiple phases or control lines. The flat profile sits flush when chased into plaster, delivering clean, finished surfaces. Rated to 300/500V, the 1.5mm² conductor area meets UK standards for cooker and appliance circuits.
